conversion.original_title: 解释 Jenkins 的 Job、Build、Plugin、Agent 与 Executor。

body:
## 操作环境
只读配置审阅实践。提供已存在的开发者Jenkins配置导出摘要和完整来源SHA；本题不访问或修改共享服务，不触发构建或部署。

## 操作任务
读取observations.json的14个真实配置导出摘要及一个agent配置，交付findings.csv逐类区分Job/Build/Plugin/Agent/Executor；给每项绑定实际字段和不能由该字段证明的事实。交付handoff.yaml，给排队时应继续核实的证据及先后顺序。不要把14个Job当14次Build、把plugin声明当兼容运行证明或把节点槽位当整个控制器的实时吞吐。

## 产物
- findings.csv
- handoff.yaml
- review.md

## 验收方法
非作者逐项审查给定事实→结论→设计→待验证边界及完整工件；合法不同方案需说明前提，至少两类实质错误方案必须拒绝。CSV/YAML语法仅辅助；不以关键词或Python本地执行代替Jenkins原生链路。本原题为知识点应用实践，不额外声称平台操作已经完成。
answer:
### findings.csv
entity,observed,meaning,unproven
Job,14 flow-definition exports,persistent Pipeline definitions,not 14 completed builds
Build,no build record in supplied export,a particular execution needs number/result/log/input identity,neither success nor failure inferred from XML
Plugin,root and nested plugin identifiers,configuration references extension capabilities,not proof of installed compatible or successfully executed versions
Agent,jenkins-node1 with SSHLauncher and EXCLUSIVE configuration,execution node configuration with explicit assignment policy,online state and controller communication not measured
Executor,numExecutors=1 in this agent export,one configured concurrent work slot on this node,not total controller capacity or measured throughput


### handoff.yaml
scope: read_only_export_review
observed_job_definitions: 14
observed_node:
  name: jenkins-node1
  configured_executors: 1
  observed_online_state: unknown
queue_investigation:
  - obtain timestamped queue reasons and job label requirements
  - correlate actual agent online state and available executors at that timestamp
  - correlate controller scheduling and the particular Build number/result/log
  - inspect tool/plugin/runtime compatibility and workload resource use
changes_applied: false


### review.md
Job是持久任务定义，Build是一次具体执行；提供的XML只证明配置。插件扩展能力，不能由配置里的plugin标签证明目标端安装兼容或流水线成功。Agent提供执行环境，executor是其并发槽位；1只是该导出节点的配置值，不是整个Jenkins的吞吐测量。节点使用EXCLUSIVE配置应结合任务选择条件核查调度；实际在线状态、权限和构建历史均待证。本题仅审阅已有脱敏配置摘要，不执行作业或改变服务。

exercise.environment: 已有真实只读Jenkins导出摘要+明确规划场景；不执行平台变更
exercise.verification: 逐项人工语义审查、实质错误与合法不同设计对照；API/seed/题型及字段隔离另有证据

conversion.original_title: 比较 Jenkins Freestyle、Pipeline 与 Multibranch Pipeline 的适用场景。

body:
## 操作环境
只读配置审阅实践。提供已存在的开发者Jenkins配置导出摘要和完整来源SHA；本题不访问或修改共享服务，不触发构建或部署。

## 操作任务
observations.json是已有14个Pipeline配置的真实只读摘要，不含Freestyle或Multibranch实测。另有三种规划场景：A单分支且步骤固定的小任务；B需审查的多阶段、暂停与重试流程；C频繁分支/PR且每分支自带Jenkinsfile。交付selection.csv分别比较Freestyle/Pipeline/Multibranch并作选择；交付transition.yaml说明现有14项迁移或保持、版本/插件/发现策略/信任边界及验证和退回条件。review.md需说明为什么界面能建任务不是充分依据，哪些是实际导出事实、哪些是设计与待验证假设。不得把计划称为已迁移或实际构建。

## 产物
- selection.csv
- transition.yaml
- review.md

## 验收方法
非作者逐项审查给定事实→结论→设计→待验证边界及完整工件；合法不同方案需说明前提，至少两类实质错误方案必须拒绝。CSV/YAML语法仅辅助；不以关键词或Python本地执行代替Jenkins原生链路。本原题为知识点应用实践，不额外声称平台操作已经完成。
answer:
### selection.csv
scenario,choice,reason,prerequisites,alternative
A,Freestyle,simple stable ordered steps,controlled config and agent/tool permissions,Pipeline also valid when review/versioning is required
B,Pipeline,reviewable Jenkinsfile expresses stages and control flow,core/plugin compatibility and durable state/credential scope review,Freestyle only if requirements simplified and limitations accepted
C,Multibranch Pipeline,discover branch Jenkinsfiles with per-branch items,approved branch source plugin and indexed branch/PR trust filters,explicit Pipeline jobs with versioned inventory if automatic discovery is unavailable


### transition.yaml
scope: proposed_design_not_applied
existing_exports:
  count: 14
  observed_type: Pipeline
  observed_multibranch_or_freestyle_runs: none
keep_existing_until_verified: true
prerequisites:
  - pin supported core and plugin versions and review dependencies
  - verify branch source capability and explicit scan schedule/webhook policy
  - separate trusted branches from PR credentials and executable code trust
  - preserve existing job configuration and recorded inputs
acceptance_plan:
  - approved branch discovered and matching Jenkinsfile selected
  - unapproved PR cannot receive protected credentials
  - renamed/deleted branch handled according to reviewed retention policy
  - stage failure/retry and artifact/log correlation verified before cutover
rollback_plan:
  - disable new trigger before restoring only the previous approved trigger
  - preserve existing jobs and historical records
  - reconcile in-flight work to avoid duplicate side effects
actual_platform_runs_in_this_exercise: 0


### review.md
导出14个flow-definition说明提供的是Pipeline任务定义；没有Freestyle/Multibranch实际执行证据。Freestyle适合简单固定步骤；Pipeline适合可审查版本化多阶段流程；Multibranch在支持的branch source配置下管理不同分支的Jenkinsfile。自动扫描/PR发现与信任策略依赖配置及插件，不应假定默认永远发现全部新分支或安全隔离。A可选Pipeline以统一审查，C也可采用受管显式Pipeline清单，但要说明发现、保留和维护成本。任务类型选择还需考虑权限、恢复和维护责任，不以UI按钮或plugin标签替代验收。本工件未创建任务、提交、构建或部署。
